_comment: Penalties under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (as amended in 2019). Amounts follow the Delhi Traffic Police fine list; some states compound differently, so adjust for your state. 'court': true means the amount is decided by a court and 'amount' is the minimum.

Helmet Non Compliance.offence: Riding without a protective helmet (rider or pillion rider)
Helmet Non Compliance.note: Driving licence liable to be disqualified for 3 months

Seatbelt Non Compliance.offence: Driving or travelling without wearing a seat belt

Triple Riding.offence: Carrying more than one pillion rider on a two-wheeler
Triple Riding.note: Driving licence liable to be disqualified for 3 months

Red Light Violation.note: Court challan: penalty decided by the court

Wrong Side Driving.offence: Driving against the authorised flow of traffic
Wrong Side Driving.note: Court challan: penalty decided by the court
